claims: In NCAA Men’s Division I basketball tournament history, only two No. 16 seeds have defeated a No. 1 seed out of 160 matchups.
No. 1 seeds have a 158-2 record against No. 16 seeds in NCAA Men’s Division I basketball tournament history.
The UMBC Retrievers became the first 16-seed to defeat a 1-seed.
Fairleigh Dickinson became the second 16-seed to defeat a 1-seed.
Before 2018, No. 1 seeds were 135-0 against 16-seeds in NCAA Men’s Division I basketball tournament.
